I: › [ I ] to move up and down quickly and gently, especially on the surface of water
（尤指在水面上）輕輕地快速上下晃動
I usually + adv/prep, T: › [ I usually + adv/prep,  T ] to move quickly in a particular direction

C: › [ C ] plural bobs a women's hairstyle with the hair cut to neck length all around the head
› [ C ] plural bob UK old-fashioned informal a
shilling : a British coin used in the past
› [ C ] plural bobs a quick movement up and down

NONE: › small things or jobs of different types
零碎的東西；零工，零活兒
› used to mean that something will happen very quickly and simply
很容易就解決了；一切如意

example: In the harbour, the boats bobbed gently up and down on the water.
港口裡的船隻在水面上輕輕地上下晃動。
I dropped the bottle into the water and watched it bob up to the surface a moment later.
我把瓶子丟進海裡，觀察到它一會兒又浮到水面上來了。
Suddenly a head bobbed up from behind the hedge.
突然從樹籬後面冒出一個頭來。
She bobbed a curtsy (= bent down from the knees briefly as a sign of respect) to the Queen.
她向女王行了個屈膝禮。
I've had/worn my hair in a bob for ages.
我留短髮已經很長時間了。
She acknowledged me with a quick bob of her head.
她迅速地向我點頭示意。
Just tell them you're a friend of mine and, Bob's your uncle, you'll get the job.
就告訴他們你是我的一個朋友，放心好了，你會得到那份工作的。

NONE: › (of a style of women's hair) cut to neck length all around the head
（女式）齊耳短髮的，剪bob 頭的

example: short, bobbed hair
齊耳短髮

NONE: › a small round or tube-shaped object around which thread is put, often to go in a sewing machine
（常指放入縫紉機的）繞線筒，線軸

C: › mainly UK US pompom a small, round ball of soft material used as decoration
› UK US pill a small ball of thread that develops on clothing or furniture covered in cloth
（衣物或布面傢俱上起的）小線球，小毛球

I: › [ I ] If a piece of clothing or material bobbles, it develops small balls of threads on its surface.

T: › [ T ] US to drop or almost drop a ball that you are trying to catch or stop
（差一點）漏接球；接球後（差一點）丟

example: I've only worn this jumper twice, and it's already begun to bobble.
這件套衫我只穿了兩次，卻已經開始起毛球了。
The right fielder bobbled an easy grounder.
右外場員漏了一個很容易的地滾球。

NONE: › a hat made from wool with a small, round wool ball on top
（頂部有小圓羊毛球的）羊毛帽子
› a police officer
員警

example: People liked seeing their friendly local/neighbourhood bobby on his beat.
人們喜歡看到友好的當地員警來回巡邏。

NONE: › a U-shaped metal pin that is tightly bent and slides into the hair in order to keep it back off the face or to keep part of the hair in position
髮夾
› a North American wild animal of the cat family with brown hair, pointed ears, and a short tail
紅貓，短尾貓（一種北美野貓）
› a dish made with minced (= very finely cut) meat, spices, and dried fruit, baked with a mixture containing eggs on top
咖喱肉末
› a small vehicle with long metal blades under it, built for racing down tracks covered with ice
大雪橇
